description: Find live Australian jobs that match a resume or LinkedIn profile. Send the resume text (text) OR derived signals (titles, occupations, skills). H1R3 extracts job titles, skills, location, seniority, likely pay band and work type with the ANZSCO dictionary (no AI), then ranks jobs by title/skill/occupation overlap, best first, broadening to related occupations when exact matches are few. Nothing is stored. Never send LinkedIn URLs: paste text or a Save-to-PDF export.

text.description: resume / profile text, max 60,000 chars; used in memory only

name: match_profile
